Title: Le prediche volgari di San Bernardino da Siena dette nella piazza del Campo l'anno MCCCCXXVII, ora primamente edite da Luciano Banchi. Volume terzo ed ultimo
Creator: Bernardino of Siena (1380-1444); sermons preached at Siena, 1427, taken down by a listener; edited by Luciano Banchi (1820-1887)
Publisher: Siena: Tip. Edit. all'inseg. di S. Bernardino (the year is not legible in the OCR of this volume's title page)
Publication Date: not legible in the OCR; the item's date field reads 1880, the year of volume 1
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: the title page of this volume prints no year the OCR can read; volume 1 of the same edition and imprint is dated MDCCCLXXX and volume 2 MDCCCLXXXIV on their title pages; the item's date field reads 1880; the editor died in 1887; the host record carries no rights field. Rights rest on the host date and the series imprint, not on a year read in this volume.
Language: ita
Source: Internet Archive item lepredichevolgar03bern (archive.org/details/lepredichevolgar03bern), full-text file lepredichevolgar03bern_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the Library thread, October 2026.
Provenance note: Toronto copy digitised by the Internet Archive. Italian OCR sampled at opening, middle and end: clean. Header prepended by the Library thread; the OCR text follows unchanged apart from this header. Nothing stripped, normalised, corrected, re-spaced or retyped.
Content note: Volume 3 of 3 ('terzo ed ultimo'): sermons XXXI to XLV, ending with the sermon on St Francis and the last sermon of the cycle, followed by the index. Italian only; see the Orlandi and Robins selection in English.

XXXI. 

Come  si  de' perseverare  insino  al  fine  chi  vuole  avere  la  corona. 

Qui  autem  perseveraverit  usque  in  finem ,  hic  saìvus  erit. 
(Matthei^  X  eap.  ).  Dilettissimi,  le  parole  prealegate  so’di 
Matteo  al  decimo  capitolo  ;  e  in  sentenzia  volgare  dicono 
così:  —  Colui  il  quale  perseverarà  insino  a  la  fine,  costui 
sarà  salvo.  — ■  Chi  insino  a  la  fine  perseverarà,  in  vita  e- 
terna  n’andarà.  E  io  v’avevo  impromesso  ieri  di  predicarvi 
stamane  d’  un’  altra  materia,  [che  io  non  vi  predicarò]* 
per  paura  che  ’l  tempo  non  ci  levi  dal  Campo/  Distingue 
tempora.^  et  concordabis  scripiuras:  —  Distingue  i  tempi,^ 
e  concordarai  le  scritture.  —  E  bench’  io  vi  lassi  quella 
materia  che  era  bellissima  e  utile,  nondimeno  questa  sarà 
utilissima  a  coloro  che  ci  sono  ;  e  però  io  dirò  a  quelli
